title: Tampa Murder Mystery Outdoor Detective Escape Game
includes: Flexibility to pause or resume anytime
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Step into a world of suspense with "Death in the Shadows," an interactive, self-guided murder mystery walking tour in Tampa. A famous blogger was found dead on a ghost tour. The police are stumped, and it’s up to your team to crack the case! Was the killer her obsessed boyfriend, or the tour guide?

Starting at the Glazer Children's Museum, you become the lead detectives. Navigate downtown Tampa, unlocking hidden gems and iconic landmarks like the Tampa Theatre by solving 12 location-based puzzles on your smartphone.

What makes this the perfect Tampa adventure:
 Total Flexibility: No strict schedules. Start anytime, pause for lunch at the Riverwalk, and resume at your own pace.
 Highly Interactive: Don't just listen to a guide. You are the main character, actively exploring the city.
 Perfect Group Activity: Great for date night, team-building, or family fun.
 Unbeatable Value: One ticket covers your entire team!
